govdocs-archive_org-nsia-USSRInformation: Harold Weisberg wrote to the information officer at the USSR Embassy in Washington on July 2, 1991. The Soviet Union had only months left to exist when the letter was sent. Weisberg, the veteran assassination researcher, kept up a wide correspondence with officials at home and abroad. The letter shows him still working his contacts and questions in the last summer of the Cold War.
